question: How should pavilions and similar elements be positioned in the layout?
premises: Each single part is allocated in sequence.
Pavilions and similar elements are to be placed.
inference: One should place the pavilion and similar elements by allocating each single part in turn.
uncertainties: kūṭa+śa+ādikaṃ interpreted as pavilion and related elements
